Parameters ---------- username : str The user's name as entered. bio : str A user-written biography that may contain multiple sentences. status_message : str A brief, current status message provided by the user. Returns ------- str A formatted string containing the sanitized profile ready for display. Raises ------ ValueError If any of the required arguments are missing or if PROFILE_FORMAT is not a string. """ # Basic validation for arg_name, arg_value in ( ("username", username), ("bio", bio), ("status_message", status_message), ): if not isinstance(arg_value, str): raise ValueError(f"{arg_name!r} must be a string") if not isinstance(PROFILE_FORMAT, str): raise ValueError("PROFILE_FORMAT must be a string template") # Escape user-provided content to prevent XSS and injection attacks safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(bio, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status_message, quote=True) # Format the profile string try: rendered = PROFILE_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, bio=safe_bio, status_message=safe_status ) except KeyError as exc: raise ValueError(f"Missing placeholder in PROFILE_FORMAT: {exc}") from None return rendered
